Do you enjoy working with your hands, like variety in your job, and want to see the results of your work every day? At Amtra Mobiele Ruimte, you'll work on a wide range of projects across the Benelux. One day you'll be assembling modular units on-site, the next you'll be carrying out maintenance or coordinating a team of technicians. No two days are the same. Earn between €2,700 and €3,700 gross per month while building your future with a growing family-owned company. What’s your job about? As a Service Technician / Site Supervisor, you will be responsible for assembling, dismantling, maintaining and delivering modular units at customer locations. You will work independently or together with colleagues on a variety of projects, ensuring everything is completed safely, efficiently and to a high standard. Your responsibilities include: Assembling, dismantling and maintaining modular units; Installing walls, doors, locks and fittings; Performing carpentry, sawing, painting and finishing work; Installing electrical wiring and lighting; Making units windproof and watertight; Coordinating technicians and maintenance activities on-site; Reading CAD drawings and translating them into practical execution; Managing construction and installation materials. What do you get in return? A gross monthly salary between €2,700 and €3,700, dependingon your experience and skills; A full-time position within a stable and growing family-owned company; A varied job with projects across the Netherlands and Belgium; Opportunities to follow technical training courses and obtain certifications; Excellent career development opportunities; Competitive primary and secondary employment conditions; A friendly and informal working environment where colleagues support each other. Amtra B.V. specialises in the rental and installation of modular units for both temporary and long-term accommodation solutions. From its Dutch branch, the company delivers projects throughout the Benelux. Amtra is part of a German family-owned business with more than 25 years of experience. Quality, teamwork and short communication lines are at the heart of the organisation. You'll join an informal team where people work hard, help each other and enjoy building impressive projects together.
